market_summary: During the London/NY overlap, metals and crypto (XAUUSD and BTCUSD) exhibit pronounced downward trend expansions below their respective daily Value Areas and -2 ATR bands, backed by negative CVD. However, both have reached structural session lows and are severely extended, presenting poor risk-reward for late trend continuation. Concurrently, FX majors (EURUSD and GBPUSD) remain trapped in tight mean-reverting ranges inside their Value Areas and across VWAP/EMA baselines, with no volume breakouts or clear directional catalyst. Across all four symbols, discipline favors waiting for cleaner pullbacks or decisive breakout retests.

signals.rationale: VP shows price deeply below VAL (3947.11) and below POC (3978.35). CVD is strongly BEARISH at -8.31 with negative slope (-3.55), fully confirming trend momentum. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is far below downward-sloping VWAP (3960.92) and EMA50 (3952.99). ATR bands are expanding, with the signal candle and live price pressing below the -2 ATR lower band (3911.74). Breakdown confirmed by recent yellow RVOL spikes (>2.0). However, the market is severely extended into Session Low support (3884.62) with a minor forming bar bounce (live 3892.20), posing high risk for chasing a breakdown into support.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below declining VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance below previous S/R levels, testing Session Low 3884.62

signals.rationale: VP shows price inside Value Area (VAL 1.10801 to VAH 1.10976) and below POC (1.10928). CVD is NEUTRAL (+4,771) with modest positive slope, showing lack of directional commitment. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price sits right at VWAP (1.10861) and below EMA50 (1.10884). Price is mid-channel between ATR upper (1.11013) and lower (1.10737) bands. Volume is normal with RVOL 1.697 following a recent sweep of Prev Low support (1.10824). With price chopping directly around fair value inside the value area, there is no high-probability directional edge.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral hovering around flat VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance inside value area, retesting Prev Low 1.10824

signals.rationale: VP indicates price is trading inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32593 to VAH 1.32778) and below POC (1.32738). CVD is BEARISH (-5,833) with negative slope (-1760.62), diverging from the forming bullish bounce. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is oscillating tightly around VWAP (1.32656) and EMA50 (1.32677). ATR channel is balanced with price resting mid-channel (upper 1.32804, lower 1.32497). RVOL is low at 1.063, lacking yellow-bar momentum confirmation. Price is trapped between S/R at 1.32661 and Prev Low 1.32618. Absence of expansion or directional breakout warrants a hold.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral consolidating at VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: VP highlights strong imbalance with price far below VAL (73260.85) and POC (73517.38). CVD is BEARISH (-0.07) with negative slope, confirming persistent downward pressure. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Trend is distinctly bearish below downward sloping VWAP (73371.34) and EMA50 (73264.39). Signal candle closed below the lower -2 ATR band (72397.07), showing an extreme volatility stretch. RVOL registered a yellow spike of 2.0+ during the initial flush 3 bars ago and is now tapering (RVOL 1.518). Price is hovering directly above Session Low support at 72155.80, making a fresh short extended and vulnerable to mean-reversion snapback.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish steep selloff below VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: consolidation above Session Low 72155.80 after breaking Prev Low 73097.30
